tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt from it. This sits alongside the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It is one paragraph and says TLS certificate verification stays on for all builds, development builds included, with no exemptions. It also notes the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.

The verification statement comes from the recorded decision "verification on all builds" (#27). That decision withdrew the earlier one that let dev builds skip verification, and I left the withdrawn stance out of the file. I didn't open the record #30 replaced, because it is retired and not served. So "HTTPS everywhere" is the only content taken from #30.
